assets.purpose: Drift's existing product mark. It sits at the top of the sidebar next to the workspace switcher, and in the default-browser dialog.
requirements: Use the file as it is; do not redraw, recolour or replace it
Render at 20px in the sidebar and 32px in the dialog, with an accessible name of 'Drift'
Keep the embedded c2pa provenance metadata in the file
assets.composition: The square app mark, centred in its slot, with no tile, circle or background behind it, on the stone frame or on the white dialog.

assets.purpose: Inter Variable: the interface typeface for every surface, at weights 400, 500 and 600, with tabular figures for counts, sizes and match numbers.
requirements: Already loaded in src/renderer/style.css via @font-face (format woff2-variations); the file's magic bytes are wOF2
Licensed under the SIL OFL 1.1 (src/renderer/fonts/OFL.txt, Inter Project Authors)
Build must check document.fonts.check('500 14px "Inter Variable"') after document.fonts.ready, and confirm tabular-nums changes the digit widths
